description: NLFF reconstructs a coronal magnetic field from photospheric vector measurements. It solves a constrained non-linear force-free optimisation problem to approximate magnetic structure above the solar surface. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Its force-free assumptions and boundary measurements limit interpretation of the reconstructed field. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
